question: What is the difference from all mantras beginning with praṇava?
premises: the comparison is with all mantras
those mantras have one-syllable self beginning with praṇava
inference: The difference is measured against all mantras whose essential form is a single syllable beginning with praṇava.
uncertainties: the exact point of difference is not explicit in this verse
plain_english: The difference is from all mantras whose self is one syllable beginning with praṇava.
